mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening economic activity, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO shows a sustained upward trend (measured by 3-month rolling increase).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 10.0%, it signals a severe labor market downturn that often precedes corporate profit declines and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 10.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 10.0% is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer and housing demand, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase month-over-month, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a zero-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative policy compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 215, it indicates elevated inflation that often triggers central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 215, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 215 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which typically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS shows a sustained upward trend (3-month rolling increase).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 570, it signals a robust housing market that typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 570, or the Rank IC for HOUST > 570 is below 0.03.
